content: Kunlani Bu Kielie
"Ta kunlai bu kielie, pse taiye kieliene.
Ta kunlai matui kieliese taiye qingiezhi kieliene. Ta yanghala nanjizhi ogise tandeye yanghala nanjizhi ogine.
Chi yangiezhi gaijiune nudundedu osun zhazhai chanlane, goya nudundedu lianni chanla dane?
Chii nudunde lian bidene matui gaijiudene, 'Bi chini nudundedu osun zhazhai agiye.' giezhi kieliene?
Chi ene jiazhon giesan kun, xien goya nudundedu lianni agidene uzhezhi qinchu olusenu gaijiune nudundedu osun zhazhai agi."
"Zhiguitu dunxini nogheide bu ogi. Ochira daozhese tai zhoune. Manouni khigheini melie bu tei. Khigheila manouni taine."
Xiahua Giese Tande Ogine
"Ta xiahua gie, tande ogine. Erei, ereizhi olune. Wijienni eghi, tande niene.
Xiahua giechen kunlade ogine. Ereichen kunla ereizhi olune. Wijienni eghichen kunlade niene.
Tai dunda yan kunyi kewon ginan kerese tashi ogine?
Zhaghasun kerese moghei ogine?
Ta gou wiliuzhe kesiladene gouni ogikuni mejiene, asiman jieredu Adatai xiahua giechen kunlade gou dunxini genjia ulie oginu?
Ingiese ta kunlai goyadene matugie gieghaku duranshi taye kunlade qingiezhi gie. Eneshi guijin, xienzhilai shu wo."
Witan Wijiense Oro
"Ta witan wijiense oro. Fugughakude uduruku wijien fugie wo. Mo aghui wo. Orochen kun olon wo.
Aminde uduruku wijien witan wo. Mo yozhi chijia wo. Ereizhi oluchen kun choghon wo."
Alimaghala Mutunni Mejiene
"Ta jia xienzhilai fangula. Hhela ghoni arasunyi zhozhi tai enende irene, sudoroni wizha zhanghei wo.
Hhelai alimaghala hhelai tanine. Eghesun jierese putou zhei shidanu? Osun jierese uhuago zhei shidanu?
Jien gou mutun jiere gou alima soune. Langan mutun jiere langan alima soune.
Gou mutun jiere langan alima sou dane. Langan mutun jiere gou alima sou dane.
Jien gou alima ulie souku mutunlai chizhidene khande teine.
Ingiese hhelai alimaghala hhelai tanine."
"Mii, 'Ezhan, Ezhan!' giezhi waradachen kunla man asiman gojiade orokui pusho. Zinie asimandedu Adaimi kielien mutun giechen kunla orone.
Hhe zuihouku udude olon kunla made kieliene, 'Ezhan, Ezhan, bijien chini niereghala chonjiwola? Chini niereghala sheitanlai touwola? Chini niereghala olon nenlitu shiqin giewola?'
Hhe shihoude bi mindaminji hhelade kieliene, 'Bi tai tani dane. Ta enezighan uhun kunla, mase likai gie!'"
Tashi, Shazi Jiere Beighasan Gie
"Ingiese mii enezighan kielienyi chenliedene giesan kunshi jienzha kun wo. Hoxian gieni fugie tashi jiere giesanghala niekielien wo.
Ghura bou, fugie usu chunji, kei hende feiliezhi eghiliuzhe gieni ulie enbereine. Gieni jigunni fugie tashi jiere giezho.
Mii enezighan kielienyi chenliedene ulie giesan kunshi men kun wo. Hoxian gieni shazi jiere giesanghala niekielien wo.
Ghura bou, fugie usu chunji, kei hende feiliezhi eghise gie enbereine. Da enbereisan fugie wo."
Ersa enezighan kielienyi jianji baraghase olon kunla hhe sughasande ghanirazho.
Ersa hhelade sughadan hhelai jinwun hanjialai buxian wo, nie qienlitu kunni xianli.
